plugins.name: Equalizer
plugins.description: Analytics tools, skills, and agents for ABF transaction analysis on the Equalizer platform
plugins.longDescription:
Equalizer Plugin for Claude Code provides comprehensive analytics and data access for the Equalizer platform. Access transaction data, run curated analytics, and generate professional reports using Claude Code's AI-powered interface.

Features:
- MCP Server connections to all Equalizer tenant environments
- 7 tools per tenant: SPV search, analytics discovery, data retrieval, stratification views, and URL generation
- Specialized analytics skill for KPI analysis and comprehensive reporting
- Multi-step analytics agent for complex transaction analysis
- OAuth2/OIDC authentication via Keycloak
- Support for cross-SPV comparisons and filtered queries
features: MCP Server with 7 tools per tenant
Analytics skill for KPI queries and reports
useCases: Query specific KPI data from SPVs
Compare credit performance across multiple SPVs
Analyze prepayment rates and stratification data
Filter and retrieve specific transaction subsets
Export data in CSV format for further analysis

authentication.description: Authenticate via Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC when first connecting to a tenant
